zh: 安装时可选择安装位置；后续升级将自动沿用所选位置进行安装。
新增使用时长与积分功能：累计使用满 2 小时积 1 分，可在「关于」页面查看已使用天数与当前积分。
新增站长管理页面，支持账号管理与申诉处理。
优化电脑端好友功能：登录后点开即可直接进入；同时修复一批入口打开为空白或显示 404 的问题。
修复服务器重启或连接恢复后，好友等页面无法识别已有登录状态、长时间无响应的问题。
新增隐私锁功能：为电脑开启隐私锁并设置一次性密码后，即可锁定该电脑的本地屏幕。
依据主流桌面软件的设计规范统一界面：电脑、手机、网页三端的按钮、卡片与间距采用同一标准。
en: The installation location can now be selected during setup; subsequent upgrades will automatically use the selected location.
Added usage time and points: 1 point is earned for every 2 hours of cumulative use. Days of use and the current points balance can be viewed on the About page.
Added an administrator page for the site owner, supporting account management and appeal handling.
Improved the friends feature on desktop: after signing in, it opens directly. Also fixed a group of entries that opened blank pages or returned 404.
Fixed an issue where, after a server restart or connection recovery, pages such as Friends failed to recognize the existing sign-in state and remained unresponsive.
Added the privacy lock: after enabling it for a computer and setting a one-time password, the computer's local screen can be locked.
Unified the interface according to mainstream desktop software design standards: buttons, cards, and spacing now follow one standard across Windows, Android, and the web.
The interface has been fully refreshed: the web console, the Windows app, and the Android app now share one visual style, with consistent colors, cards, and buttons.
The friends feature is connected: after signing in once, selecting “Friends” in the app or the web console opens it directly, with no second sign-in.
Dark mode and related details have been refined, including the reconnection, About, and update pages.
zh: 界面全面更新：网页版、电脑版与手机版采用统一的视觉样式，配色、卡片与按钮保持一致。
好友功能打通：登录一次后，在软件与网页中点「好友」即可直接打开，无需再次登录。
优化深色模式与相关细节：断线重连、关于与更新等页面均已调整，使用更顺畅。

en: A registration entry has been added: new accounts can now be created directly from the sign-in screen.
zh: 新增注册入口：可在登录界面直接注册新账号。

en: Version 2.0.0: a Forum entry has been added to the app; select “Forum” in the toolbar to open it.
The device page has gained a privacy-lock switch, available once the companion component on the controlled computer is deployed (the component is distributed with this release).
A group of prompts has been shortened and refined for clarity.
zh: 发布 2.0.0 版本：软件内新增论坛入口，点工具栏的「论坛」即可进入。
设备页面新增隐私锁开关：被控电脑上的配套组件部署完成后即可使用（组件随本版本一同下发）。
精简并优化了一批提示文案，表述更清晰。

en: A new brand mark has been adopted — a blue broken ring with an orange dot — now used consistently in the Windows app, the Android app, and the console.
No functional changes in this release.
zh: 启用全新品牌标志：蓝色断环加橙色圆点，电脑版、手机版与网页控制台统一采用。
本版本无功能变化。

en: Friends have been added: select “Friends” in the toolbar, search by the other party's account name, and send a request; once accepted, you are friends.

A group of your computers can be shared with a friend for assistance: view-only by default (the screen can be viewed but not operated); whether operation is allowed is chosen at sharing time. Removing the friend withdraws the sharing automatically and immediately.
Friends can chat with end-to-end encryption throughout; the server stores no plaintext. The friends list also includes official support, answered by the site owner personally.
The Android app has been updated to 1.0.5 in step, including friends, sharing, and chat, with in-app update checks connected.
All previous features remain: in-app updates, automatic reconnection after disconnection, one-click copying of diagnostics, and all shortcuts.
zh: 新增好友功能：可在工具栏点「好友」打开，按对方账号搜索并发送申请，对方同意后即成为好友。
支持将自己的一组电脑共享给好友协助处理：默认仅可查看（可看屏幕、不可操作），是否允许操作由共享时选择；删除好友后，共享立即自动收回。
好友之间支持聊天，内容全程端到端加密，服务器不保存明文；好友列表中设有官方客服，由站长本人回复。
安卓版同步更新至 1.0.5：包含好友、共享与聊天功能，并已接入软件内更新检查。
此前功能保持不变：软件内更新、断线自动重连、诊断信息一键复制与各项快捷键。

en: Update rules have changed: while the app is running, a new version is announced by a reminder only and never interrupts use. The next time the app is reopened after being closed, the new version is installed first, with a progress bar shown and an automatic integrity check afterwards. If the server is unreachable when the app is opened, it can still be entered and used; the app is never locked.
The About panel has gained a Register New Account button and a brief explanation of the update rules, for easier registration.

All previous features remain: in-app update checks with verified downloads, one-click copying of diagnostics, shortcuts (F5 refresh, F9 screenshot, F10 always-on-top, F11 fullscreen), and automatic reconnection after disconnection.
zh: 更新规则调整：软件运行期间发现新版本时仅作提醒，不中断使用；退出后下次打开时，先完成新版本安装再进入，安装过程显示进度条，完成后自动校验完整性。若打开软件时无法连接服务器，仍可进入使用，不会锁定软件。
「关于」面板新增「注册新账号」按钮与更新规则说明，便于注册新账号。
此前功能保持不变：软件内检查更新、下载校验、诊断信息一键复制、快捷键（F5 刷新、F9 截图、F10 置顶、F11 全屏）与断线自动重连。

en: In-app updates have been added: the app checks for new versions on launch and can be checked manually from the About panel; a download is verified for integrity before installation is offered.
The About panel has gained one-click copying of diagnostics, so a problem report carries all information needed for diagnosis.
Shortcuts have been completed: F5 refresh, F9 screenshot, F10 always-on-top, F11 fullscreen.
zh: 新增软件内更新：打开软件时自动检查新版本，「关于」中也可手动检查；下载完成后先校验完整性，确认无误才提示安装。
「关于」新增一键复制诊断信息功能，便于出现问题时提交完整的定位信息。
补齐快捷键：F5 刷新、F9 截图、F10 置顶、F11 全屏。

en: Dual toolbar themes have been added: bright blue and deep gray can be switched with one click, and the splash, loading, and offline screens follow.
A server status light has been added to the toolbar, showing at a glance whether the server is reachable, with the latest check result and time available on selection.
One-click screenshot has been added: the current console view can be saved as an image.
The About panel has been completed: version number, build date, and a server status self-check button.
zh: 工具栏新增双主题：亮蓝与深灰可一键切换，启动、加载与断线页面随之变色。
工具栏新增服务器状态指示灯：可直观查看服务器是否可达，点开可查看最近一次检测结果与时间。
新增一键截图：可将当前控制台画面保存为图片。
补全「关于」面板：包含版本号、构建日期与服务器状态自检按钮。

en: The interface has been fully redesigned: new icon, a bright-blue gradient toolbar, and glass-style card pages.
Two-layer automatic reconnection: full-page drops retry automatically on a countdown; session drops reconnect automatically — unlimited retries, no pop-ups, and no return to the sign-in page.
Fullscreen mode, page zoom with a percentage display, and always-on-top have been added.
The app remembers window size and position; launching it again brings the existing window forward instead of opening another.
zh: 界面整体重新设计：新图标、亮蓝渐变工具栏、玻璃质感卡片页面。
断线自动重连双重保障：整页断开时按倒计时自动重试；会话断开时自动重新连接，不限次数、不弹窗打扰、不退出登录。
新增全屏、页面缩放（带百分比显示）与窗口置顶功能。
软件可记住窗口大小与位置；重复打开时仅唤起已有窗口，不再重复开启。

en: The first QFRemote Windows app: double-click to open the console directly — no browser and no certificate prompts.
Sign in once and the state is remembered; later launches enter directly.
Own brand icon and toolbar; the server address is built into the app, which connects only to the official server, reducing the risk of spoofing.
zh: QFRemote 首个 Windows 软件版发布：双击即可打开并直接进入控制台，无需再开浏览器或处理证书提示。
登录一次后可保持登录状态，后续打开无需再次登录。
采用自有品牌图标与工具栏；服务器地址内置于软件中，仅连接官方服务器，降低被假冒的风险。
